moments.text: Very dark upright phone video at night: a dim vertical light streak upper left and faint dark bars forming a grid across the frame.
A tiny yellowish point of light sits just below the horizontal bar, left of centre. Brighten the screen to see it.
The point of light now shows just above the bar, under the lower tip of the light streak, and stays there as the phone shifts slightly.

notes: Extremely dark footage; detail only visible with heavy brightening.
